note: How-to steps for the WhatsApp invite (HC Admin → Releases). Updated in the SAME commit as every Home Class build that changes what a family does (CLAUDE.md rule). WhatsApp formatting: *bold* _italic_.
text:
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
📥 *STEP 1 – INSTALL (ONE app for everyone)*
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
👉 {kidApk}
Install it on the *parent's phone*, the *child's phone* and the *Android / Google TV* – it is the same app.
1. Tap the link → *Download*.
2. Open the downloaded file → *Install*.
3. If Android says *"not allowed to install unknown apps"* → tap *Settings* → turn ON *"Allow from this source"* → go back → *Install*.
When it opens it asks, one after another - tap *Allow* each time: *Microphone*, *Notifications*, *"Display over other apps"* (class time opens the app by itself), *battery* and *"Install unknown apps"* (updates install by themselves).
The first time it downloads its listening engine (about 40 MB) – use Wi-Fi.

The app asks *"Who uses this phone?"*
👨‍👩‍👧 *Parent* · 🧒 *Child* · 🏠 *Shared phone* (one phone at home). A TV is found by itself. You can change it later in ⚙️ *Settings* → 📱 *This phone is for*. The app reopens on the screen you used last.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
👨‍👩‍👧 *STEP 2 – SET UP YOUR FAMILY (2 min)*
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
On the *parent's phone* (choose 👨‍👩‍👧 Parent):
1. Type your *family name* (e.g. Sharma) → tap 🏠 *Start a new family*.
2. ⚙️ *Settings* → *Add a child* → first name, class, 👦/👧, 🎂 date of birth → *➕ Add*.
3. Under the child: *Tables from / to*, *Learn step by step* or *Quick revision*, *Class time* and *days* (the child's phone rings 🔔), *Minutes per class*.
4. ⚙️ *Settings* → 🔒 *Family parent PIN* → choose 4 digits. The same PIN works on every phone of the family.
5. Your *family code* (6 digits) shows on Home and under ➕ *Add a device*.
6. On the *child's phone / TV* (choose 🧒 Child) type that code → the parent's phone shows ✓ *Allow* → tap it. ✅ Linked!

👨 *Second parent?* Install the app → 👨‍👩‍👧 *Parent* → 🔗 *Join* → type the family code.
🔒 *On a child's phone* the 🔒 *Parents* button (top) opens the parent part with the family PIN; 🧒 *Kids* goes back.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🧒 *STEP 3 – HOW YOUR CHILD USES IT*
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
▶ *Start class* (or it starts by itself at class time).
🔊 Tap your *picture* to hear what you practised last (⏹ *Stop* any time). It also speaks when the app opens or on 🔄 (⚙️ *Settings* → *Speak when the app opens*).
• The app asks, e.g. *"7 2 zaa?"*
• 🎤 After the little *ding*, just *say the answer* ("fourteen") – no button needed.
• ✅ Right → stars ⭐  ❌ Wrong → the app tells the answer, the child says it back, it comes again later.
• ⏱️ A countdown shows in the last seconds; when time is up the app says the answer.
• Buttons: ⏭ *Skip* · ⏭ *Next table* · ⏸ *Pause* · ⏹ *Stop*

👁 *Hold to see*: in a table, a spelling test or a question, hold it to see the whole table / the word / the answer, let go to hide (parents: ⚙️ Settings → 👁 one switch each for tables, spelling and questions; each peek is counted).

📚 *Practise a table* → 📖 see it · 🗣️ say it after the app · 👀 say it with answers (then the app asks: *more practice* or *test*? say it or press the button – no answer = practise again) · 🙈 test without seeing (the result shows on the same screen: 🔁 Practise again / 🏠 Home). Then 5 random questions – all right = table learnt 🏅.

✏️ *Spelling* and 💬 *Questions* – add them on the parent's phone (📝 *Lessons* → ➕ *New lesson*; the title is the subject, e.g. EVS). The child spells letter by letter or answers by voice. For each spelling lesson choose 👀 *show the word* (learning) or keep it 🙈 hidden until spelt right (test).

📺 *On a TV* – every page fits the screen (⚙️ Settings has 4 tabs); in a class the Back button moves to ⏹ *Stop* (Back again stops); if the app could not hear, say *yes* / *again* or press OK; press OK on a child's picture to hear their status, OK on ▶ Start class to start. 🙈 Test: choose 🔀 Mixed or 🔢 In order on the practise screen. Remote arrows to move, OK to press. Answer with the number keys or speak into the remote 🎤. If it shows 🔴 *"Mic asleep"*, press OK, then speak.

🏠 *Google Home speaker?* Child's phone: ⚙️ → 🔊 *Speaker* → choose your Google Home (same Wi-Fi).

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
👀 *STEP 4 – WHAT PARENTS CAN DO*
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
• *Home*: your family name on top - tap it to *hear* what each child practised (or a child's photo for that child); 📋 *Today* shows it in writing. It also speaks when you open the app or press 🔄 (⚙️ *Settings* → 🔊 *Welcome summary*), never during a phone call; ⏹ *Stop* any time.
• 🔐 ⚙️ *Settings* → *Permissions*: green "all done ✅"; if something is not allowed it opens by itself - tap the ❌ line.
• *Watch live* during class; ▶ *Start* / ⏹ *Stop* from your phone.
• 📣 *Call*: rings the child's phone to come to class.
• 📝 *Lessons*: ✏️ Spelling and 💬 Questions for the school week.
• ⚙️ *Settings*: ⏸ *Turn all classes off* (holiday), answer time (10–30 s), the word the voice uses (zaa / ja…), how to say your child's name 🔊, 🔒 family PIN.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🔄 *UPDATES*
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
The app updates by itself (never during a class). Newest version right now: tap *🔄 Refresh* at the top.
_Still have the old "Home Class Parents" app? Its Home screen shows how to move in 1 minute – your family and all progress stay._
